relationships.subject: Fasudil
relationships.evidence_quote: Fasudil significantly suppressed nerve injury-induced inflammatory microglia production in the dorsal horn of the spinal cord

relationships.subject: Fasudil
relationships.evidence_quote: Here, we showed for the first time that Fasudil, a ROCK inhibitor, can prevent neuropathic pain in Minamata disease model rats.

key_findings: Fasudil prevented methylmercury-induced neuropathic pain in Minamata disease model rats.
Fasudil suppressed inflammatory microglia in the dorsal horn and prevented somatosensory cortical rewiring.
